name: en
description: The English layout, option A (docs/build-contract.md): the resident code in a new ITCM autoload section at a fixed 0x01FF9500, past the largest ITCM block any locale can have (text speed, then the trainer full-name block, which ends at 0x01FF9320 at most) with 0x1E0 to spare, its work RAM at the top of ITCM as in the Spanish build, the rest in a new main-RAM autoload section below difficulty's. The ITCM section's bss runs through the work RAM, so every boot zeroes it. Steering is compiled out (AI_NO_STEER).

words.purpose: ITCM arena start, which the input sets to the end of its ITCM block (0x01FF8FC0 after text speed, more with trainer full names; never past the AI's itcm origin): the AI's itcm region and work RAM take the rest of ITCM
main arena high (difficulty set it to 0x023DC000): the AI's main region 0x023D4000-0x023DC000 below it
